entries.227761ad5511dc4d: Handles interior and exterior components, mechanical components and molds for two-wheeled and four-wheeled vehicles. Sales in Southeast Asia consist of the vehicle field.
entries.378a8292fdfb8475: Engages in real estate leasing, non-life insurance agency sales, and contracting of civil engineering and construction work. Consolidated subsidiary Trinity Co., Ltd. is in charge of insurance agency and other services.
entries.4201c4e70b026ef1: The company and its domestic subsidiaries manufacture and sell molded products and molds for the vehicle and OA (other) fields, and also carry on other businesses; this is the largest regional business of the group. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,084 million.
entries.69d098b2ce87dcc1: This regional business manufactures and sells interior and exterior components, mechanical components and molds for two-wheeled and four-wheeled vehicles through PT Takagi Sari Multi Utama in Indonesia and Takagi Seiko Company Limited in Thailand. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,392 million.
entries.779e544f15d4619c: Handles exterior and mechanical components for printers and copiers, battery case components for automated guided vehicle robots, and molds.
entries.797a8ce5271bb406: Handles exterior and interior components for four-wheeled vehicles, battery and powertrain-related components, mechanical components using composite materials, metal sound- and heat-insulating components, exterior components and fuel tanks for two-wheeled vehicles, aerodynamic drag-reduction components and interior and exterior components for trucks, fuel tanks, urea water tanks and exterior components for construction machinery, and molds.
entries.8ba0341dd48d6bb5: Handles products and molds for the vehicle field.
entries.acf4f39fc44d140f: This regional business manufactures and sells products and molds for the vehicle and OA (other) fields through Takagi Seiko (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd., Takawa Seiko (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. and Foshan Nanhai Huada Takagi Mould Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,000 million. In the current fiscal year, the company transferred all equity interests in Takagi Automotive Parts (Foshan) Co., Ltd. and Wuhan Takagi Automotive Parts Co., Ltd., and excluded both companies from the consolidation scope.
entries.cad3e1297a162755: Handles housing components for personal computers and smartphones and other devices made with carbon fiber composite materials, and molds.
entries.d815e4539b58ff48: A plastic molded products manufacturer in Takaoka, Toyama Prefecture, that manufactures and sells vehicle parts, OA parts and molds in Japan, China and Southeast Asia.
